data.body:
Corroborating reproduction on epic 3d7a-7795-efde-4df7 (fresh /rebar-debug, 2026-08-22), cleanly isolating root-cause **A** (the `before != after` whole-tracker HEAD fence).

Read-only repro of the exact `before -> collect() -> after` triple + 3-attempt loop from generation.sign_manifest (NO signing, NO LLM), 12 trials against the live ~20-session store:
- collect() window for this epic: median 10.2s, max 12.9s, min 6.5s -- larger than the 3.3-5.8s in the RCA above because this subject is an epic with more plan-material pins (see the 3d57 link below).
- outcome: 9/12 would-sign, 3/12 EXHAUSTED all 3 attempts ("plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts") == a live ~25% sign-failure rate.
- reason histogram: {'head-move': 12} -- EVERY retry was mechanism A (before != after). Zero store-read-failure (mechanism C) and zero under-lock-mismatch in this window.

New causal link worth recording: the collect() window length is set by the SAME O(pins x4) full-store reduction as bug 3d57-602f-0b75-48ee (its confirmed RCA: current_material_fingerprint_impl -> live_material_children -> reduce_all_tickets, per pin). So the sign fence's required-quiescence window SCALES with 3d57, and 3d57's fix (one shared snapshot) shortens this window from ~10s to ~1s -- a strong partial mitigation for A, on top of the definitive fix this ticket proposes (fence against the subject's own generation, not store-wide HEAD).

Churn source (discriminating, re: any "isolate the enrich-drain" proposal): the HEAD moves are foreground `ticket: COMMENT`/`EDIT` writes from concurrent sessions -- sampled 6 moves/40s, ALL foreground; and 0 enrich-drain digest commits appeared in 21 collect() windows (the drain was blocked at 0% CPU during the sample). Isolating the drain in a dedicated clone would NOT fix this bug -- the churn is foreground.

For reference: the store-read-failure facet (mechanism C -> retryable) was fixed separately as bug ec1e-be67-8774-4eef (Gerrit 2118, merged). It converts C from terminal to retryable but does not address A, which this ticket still owns.
